title: Terralum: The Shattered Meridian
opening: The sky above Terralum has forgotten its stars. You have reached the Meridian Observatory, where a broken map may point toward the source of the silence.
first_objective: Explore the courtyard. Use Study to examine the star-map dais.
discovery: The brass rings turn beneath your hand. A buried route appears: the Hollow below the observatory. Something there is still answering the sky.
second_objective: Use Down to follow the newly revealed route.
arrival: The stone closes behind you. Ahead, the Hollow carries a faint pulse of blue light. This is where the search begins.
